executive_summary: Consumer protection safeguards buyers against market exploitation. COPRA 1986/2019 grants 6 statutory rights enforced via a three-tier quasi-judicial commission hierarchy.

storyboard.title: Market Exploitation to Statutory Rights
storyboard.description: Tracing 1960s grassroot anti-hoarding protests to COPRA's 3-tier commission network.
storyboard.key_takeaway: Organized consumer awareness enforces market accountability.

video_embeds.title: Consumer Rights, RTI & Certification Seals
video_embeds.transcript_summary: Details 6 consumer rights, RTI Act 2005 disclosures, and ISI/Agmark/Hallmark quality seals.

hotspots.popover_content: District Commission (<= ₹1 Cr), State Commission (₹1 Cr - ₹10 Cr), National Commission (> ₹10 Cr).

key_takeaways: COPRA enacted 6 fundamental statutory consumer rights.
Three-tier quasi-judicial system resolves consumer disputes.
Certification seals (ISI, Agmark, Hallmark) verify product quality.
Cash receipts serve as essential legal evidence in consumer courts.
